notes.title: Update #1: THE LEGEND BEGINS
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35765147/d0aff80600f38eff77c3cdfd71580999573e0f9d.jpg[/img]
Howdy folks! 
Now with the game out in the wild, we've gone into bug-wranglin' mode. Since then, we've been hard at work, and now it's time for the first update to Home A Drone!

Just a couple of usability issues, and in one case, under certain circumstances, that would prevent the player from progressing:

  - Buttons have been improved to feel nicer and press in easier
  - Fixed a bug where if the player dies in the first round they cannot restart the round
  - Fixed a bug that could rarely cause a button to be pressed while its arm is animating.

As always, if you have any bugs or issues we should know about, or just wanna chat, our Discord is: discord.gg/x3k5JUD
More fixes and content updates to come soon!

Keep fightin' them drones for Scrappy!

- Construct Studio
